notes.text: CODE-LED: no image generation in this harness (context.mjs reported converters only: cwebp, sips, ffmpeg). Per new-work §5 code-led is the only path; the comp round cannot run. reasons: 0 comps under .impeccable/mocks; the comp round puts three compositional options of the chosen direction in front of the user (reference/visualize.md). Generate the missing ones (harness image tool or generate-image.mjs), each with a .json sidecar holding its prompt.

no comp is approved: put the three comps in front of the user (decision page via serve-question.mjs, or the structured question tool), then set "approved": true in the chosen comp's sidecar. A delegated pick is recorded the same way and disclosed.
